items.summary_en: Google has shipped Gemini 3.8 Flash, its third Flash release in six weeks. It gains capability from more reasoning and tool calls instead of being a scaled-down Pro, notably closing the gap between flashy scores and real-world reliability.

items.summary_en: Google Cloud launched two AI database-operations agents. Both integrate with Gemini Cloud Assist, support managed services including AlloyDB, Cloud SQL, and Spanner, and work from existing console, CLI, and IDE workflows.

items.title: [分享发现] 小团队合规减负：处理 <10 万人信息的新规 9/1 已生效，数据出境免三件套
items.summary_zh: 网信办与公安部9月1日实施新规，年处理不足10万人个人信息的小型处理者可免数据出境安全评估、标准合同与认证，隐私政策只需3项要素，依托平台经营者还可直接适用平台规则。注意10万按当年累计算，敏感个人信息及重要数据不享豁免。
items.summary_en: China's simplified personal-information rules for small-scale processors took effect Sept 1. Processors handling fewer than 100,000 people's data per year are now exempt from the standard export security assessment, contract, and certification requirements, and privacy policies can be reduced to three basic elements; those operating on platforms can lean on the platform's compliance. Caveat: 100,000 is a cumulative annual count, and sensitive or important data is still excluded.

items.summary_en: Ponytail is an open-source project that pushes AI coding agents to behave like the 'laziest senior dev'—write only the minimum, and one line if that's enough. It's published as the npm package @dietrichgebert/ponytail and the README badge claims compatibility with 20 agents. Useful for developers who want AI to write less, not more.

items.summary_zh: 这篇实战文章介绍了一套浏览器端的人脸识别方案：模型约 6.5MB，图片选完后在浏览器内直接输出 128 维特征向量，核心代码只需 5 行，不需要把图片传回服务器。它主打隐私保护和低成本接入，适合做小区门禁这类对隐私敏感的前端场景。
items.summary_en: This hands-on article presents a browser-based face recognition setup with a model of roughly 6.5MB. After selecting an image, the web page computes a 128-dimensional embedding locally with only about five lines of core code, so the photo doesn’t have to be sent to a server. It’s a lightweight, privacy-friendly option for scenarios like community access control.
